title: Quick Actions
boundary: Local metadata-only quick-action surface for sync, backup, API keys, team invite, marketplace, and settings. Permission state is per-action and fail-closed: an unknown permission state disables every action, a denied state disables only the action it names, and every disabled action carries a non-blank disabled reason. Consequential actions refuse to run without explicit confirmation; the one action mapped to security_contract.sensitive_actions refuses to run before reauthentication through an injected broker, and a missing broker is fail-closed. A run is an explicit idle/running/succeeded/failed/cancelled state machine whose reported progress is monotonic, clamped, and never fabricated, and whose terminal outcome is always recorded as a visible result with a non-blank message. Every attempt, including each denial, appends exactly one redacted audit event. No sync, backup, invite, marketplace, or settings execution happens here, the product-spec billing contract stays PLANNED_NOT_VERIFIED, reference mock values cannot be produced, and public-trust signing, hosted CI, telemetry, hardware, adoption, and publication remain DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.
